title: Clubs
note: A club is your private room: your rules, your members, your standings. Share the code and play from anywhere.

join.title: Join a club
join.requestSent: Request sent — an admin must approve you.

create.title: Create a club
create.fourWindsTitle: Running a club comes with The Four Winds Club
create.fourWindsBody: Create and run up to 3 clubs with The Four Winds Club. Joining a club and playing in it is always free.

none: You are not in any club yet.

members.transferConfirm: Make %{name} the owner? You become an admin.
members.removeConfirm: Remove %{name} from the club? They also leave any club table they are at. Their standings are kept on file and come back if they rejoin.
members.banConfirm: Ban %{name}? They leave the club and its tables and cannot join again until unbanned.
members.leaveConfirm: Leave %{name}? Your standings are kept on file and come back if you rejoin. A match you are playing still counts, win or lose.
members.ownerLeave: Pass the club to another member before you leave.
members.deleteBody: This deletes the club, its standings and its history, and closes its tables. Type the club's name to confirm.

tables.noneCanOpen: No open tables. Open one and share the club code.
tables.variantNote: A variant table plays other rules and never counts toward the standings.
tables.closeConfirm: Close %{label}? The match ends now and counts for nothing.
tables.evictConfirm: Remove %{name} from this table? A bot plays their seat and they cannot come back to it.
tables.rejectAllConfirm: Reject all %{n} requests? They can ask to join again later.

rules.adminOnly: Only the owner and admins can change rules.
rules.botSkillNote: Every table in this club plays with these bots.
rules.houseNote: Tables members open always use these house rules.

signIn.title: Sign in to use clubs
signIn.body: Clubs live on the game server, so they need an account. The app makes a guest account for you when it can reach the server; bots and lessons work offline meanwhile.

season.confirmBody: Start season %{n}? This season's points are archived and everyone starts again from zero. All-time points are kept.

share.message: Join my club %{name} on %{app}. Club code %{code}: %{link}

owner.restricted: This club is not covered by an active Four Winds Club plan (the owner's plan has lapsed, or already covers 3 other clubs), so it can have one open table until the owner renews or passes the club on.

groups.special: 天胡 · 地胡 · 人胡

fields.dealerStreakTai: 連莊 extra 台 per streak hand
fields.drawKeepsDealer: 流局連莊 a drawn hand keeps the dealer
fields.heavenlyTai: 天胡 (dealer wins on the deal) 台

errors.ownLimit: You can own at most %{max} clubs.
errors.lapsedCap: This club can have only one open table until its owner renews The Four Winds Club.
errors.confirmName: Type the club's name exactly to delete it.
errors.adminOnAdmin: Only the owner can remove or ban an admin.
errors.ownerProtected: The owner cannot be removed or banned.
errors.notYourself: You cannot do that to yourself.
errors.transferLimit: That member already owns %{max} clubs, the most one account can own.
errors.joinRateIp: Too many clubs joined from this connection. Try again in an hour.
errors.joinRateClub: This club is getting a lot of join requests. Try again later.
errors.queueFull: This club has too many requests waiting. Try again later.
